extension.summary: Free films, TV shows and live channels from Tubi
extension.description:
Tubi has a large library of free, ad-supported films, TV shows and live channels. Unofficial add-on, not affiliated with Tubi.
* Home, Movies, TV Shows, Search and a Live TV guide in the add-on's own interface * Series with their seasons and episodes * Live TV guide from Tubi's own programme data, plus IPTV Manager integration for the Kodi TV guide * Context menu: add to the library, related titles, trailers, and with an account My List, like and dislike * Resume from Tubi's watch history * Optional Tubi account sign-in * Add films and shows to the Kodi library as .strm files * Add-on-local direct/custom network routing with a GeoTV media relay * PseudoTV Live support
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial add-on, not affiliated with or endorsed by Tubi. Tubi streams only in the countries it serves. Encrypted titles need a working Widevine CDM for InputStream Adaptive.
extension.news: 2026.10.13 - The add-on's own interface - NEW: Home, Movies, TV Shows, Series, Search and a Live TV guide in the add-on's own interface, with a loading screen and a navigation bar. - NEW: Live TV guide from Tubi's programme data: categories, channel logos, a half-hour timeline, the current time and programme progress. - NEW: Context menu on films and series: library export, related titles, trailer, My List, like and dislike. - NEW: Resume from Tubi's watch history in the new interface. - CHANGED: Encrypted titles go to InputStream Adaptive without a check for a Linux Widevine file or a minimum CDM version, so Android, Windows and macOS can play them. Only a CDM that would crash Kodi is refused. - FIXED: Clearing or changing the account credentials ends the previous sign-in, also when signing in with the new ones fails. - FIXED: Series and Live TV stop waiting after 20 seconds when Tubi cannot be reached; Back cancels the loading screen. Earlier changes are in the add-on's source history.
